internal.reading: Every one of the rows poses a distinct question verbatim (distinct_questions_exact == rows). Under digit blinding they collapse, and that collapse is the honest denominator for any template-driven claim: sub-bank (b)'s rows share one question template per procedure family, so its effective unit count is its cluster count, not its row count. Any paired comparison must cluster on last_user_turn_digit_blinded.

admission_audit.leakage_tolerance: ZERO on every axis against every other bank
admission_audit.redundancy_tolerance: MEASURED, NOT GATED -- digit-blinded collision inside the bank is designed, and is reported as effective clusters

corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: direct_reasoning dev has exactly 324 cells of exactly 15 rows (27 domains x 12 reasoning_families), and `decision` is FULLY DETERMINED by `reasoning_family`: 10 answerable families and 2 abstention families, so no cell contains both decisions. One-per-cell therefore yields 324 rows split 270 answer / 54 abstain, not 384 split 192 / 192.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.registered: (a) sampled one per (domain, reasoning_family, decision) cell by lowest digest, giving 384 rows = 192 answer + 192 abstain.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Keep the registered totals -- 192/192 is a deliberate property, it puts the constant-abstain floor at exactly 0.5000 -- and replace the mechanism with a deterministic largest-remainder allocation across families, then across domains, then lowest digest within the cell. Per-cell counts are recorded in full on the artifact.

corrections_to_the_registered_design.changes_a_number: No reported accuracy; it changes which rows are admitted.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: the answer_or_abstain stratum has only 5 distinct base_template_family values over its 250 rows, so a <=4 cap admits at most 20 rows -- while the same line requires 192. The cap as written is arithmetically impossible. There are 59 distinct `template_family` values (max 9 rows in one).
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Apply the cap to `template_family`, which admits at most 236 >= 192. Read as base_template_family the registered design is self-contradictory; this is the only reading under which both halves of the line can hold.

corrections_to_the_registered_design.changes_a_number: It adds a stronger analysis unit than the design believed existed: 40 within-pair abstention-calibration contrasts.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: REFUTED by the data. Every row carries `counterfactual_group_id`. Among the 250 answer_or_abstain rows there are 40 groups of size 2, and all 40 contain exactly one exact-abstain row and one answerable row differing by the presence of the decisive fact -- e.g. 'A car travels 30 mph for 4 hours. Distance?' -> '120 miles.' against 'A car travels for 4 hours, but its speed is not given. Distance?' -> the abstain string. That is precisely a decisive-evidence swap.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.registered: (c) 'the stratum only has 5 base families over 250 rows, so pairing is by shared base template, NOT by a decisive-evidence swap -- state that limitation on the artifact'.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Admit all 40 pairs (80 rows) first and carry `pair_id` on them, then fill to 96/96 from the 85 unpaired abstain and 85 unpaired answerable rows. The registered limitation is withdrawn for those 40 pairs and still stands for the other 112 rows of (c), which are unpaired.

corrections_to_the_registered_design.changes_a_number: Under the literal reading sub-bank (c) is unbuildable; this is the only reading that is not self-contradictory.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: in the answer_or_abstain stratum all 250 rows carry reply_class=insufficient_information, and exactly 125 have the exact abstain string. The other 125 are their ANSWERABLE counterparts. Excluding all 125 would leave 0 answerable rows, while the same design requires 96 of them.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.registered: HARD EXCLUSION: 'every v3 insufficient_information row that is not an EXACT abstain-string final turn'.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Read the exclusion as what it was for -- a ban on RELABELLING a non-abstain row as an abstention, which is the refusal MQ-001's build_pool.py already recorded. So: a row is ABSTAIN if and only if its final assistant turn is the exact string, and every other row is ANSWER scored against its own gold. Nothing is relabelled and no row is dropped.

corrections_to_the_registered_design.changes_a_number: It creates a channel that would otherwise have been silently merged into 'correct abstention' for 48 rows of sub-bank (b).
corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: the distinction exists in the METADATA of both sub-banks but in the RESPONSE CONTRACT of only one. direct_reasoning requires "I don't know based on the available information." for 405/405 insufficient_information rows AND for 405/405 conflicting_evidence rows -- the identical sentence. procedural_rag is the only sub-bank with a second sentence, "The available sources conflict, so I can't give one certain answer.", required by 180/180 of its conflict rows and pinned in each row's `response_contract.requirements`. My first scorer assumed one abstention sentence and its own guard rejected the build, which is how this was found.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.registered: strata (2): 'abstention cause insufficient_information vs conflicting_evidence, cross-tabulated', with the note that residual_v23 procedural_rag is one of only two banks that make the distinction.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Score the required sentence PER ROW, derived from that row's gold, over a registered two-sentence vocabulary. Report `wrong_abstention_kind` as its own channel: emitting the missing-information sentence where the sources contradict each other is a distinct failure from answering anyway, and neither is a correct abstention. The metadata cross-tabulation still stands as a difficulty contrast -- is abstention as reliable when the cause is contradiction rather than absence -- but for direct_reasoning it is NOT a contract distinction, and no report may imply that it is.

corrections_to_the_registered_design.changes_a_number: Yes, and it is the largest correction here: the effective unit count for sub-bank (b) is 16, not 192. Any interval computed on 192 independent rows there would be far too narrow.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.measured: at zero tolerance the bank refuses ITSELF. Against every other bank it is perfectly clean -- 0 collisions on all four axes against sealed.jsonl (110), sealed_roleplay_v2_DO_NOT_TRAIN.jsonl (400), dev.jsonl (510), dev_roleplay_v2.jsonl (400) and the 32 selected TRAIN worlds. But INTERNALLY, while all 768 rows pose distinct questions verbatim, digit blinding collapses them to 589 clusters: 19 clusters hold 198 rows, the largest holding 18. All the large clusters are sub-bank (b), whose 192 rows share just 16 digit-blinded question templates -- one per procedure family per contract. And sub-bank (c)'s minimal pairs collide by construction, since the pair IS the same sentence with the decisive number removed.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.registered: 'run MQ-001 data.overlap_audit ... at its zero tolerance on id / family / NFKC-casefold-normalized first user turn / digit-blinded prompt'.
corrections_to_the_registered_design.resolution: Split one verdict into two. LEAKAGE against other banks stays at zero tolerance and remains the build gate, together with 'no two rows pose the identical question'. INTERNAL REDUNDANCY is measured and published rather than gated, because deleting 198 legitimate rows would only be flattering a statistic. Instead every row carries `cluster_id` = digit-blinded last user turn, so the paired statistics layer clusters on it and cannot silently choose a looser unit.

floor_strict.meaning: A preservation result at or below this is not evidence of preserved capability. constant_abstain is the one to watch: the bank is built half-abstain by construction, so it scores about 0.5 for free.

floor_tolerant.meaning: A preservation result at or below this is not evidence of preserved capability. constant_abstain is the one to watch: the bank is built half-abstain by construction, so it scores about 0.5 for free.

what_this_is: Preservation / abstention DEV bank: ordinary useful responses plus appropriate abstention, from two non-Forge ordinary-language corpora.
why_not_confirmation: residual_capability_v23 dev was read by the completed v2.3 run's dose calibration and DEV/OOD selection, so it is selection-exposed; and every admitted v3 row is `split: train` with `human_review_status: pending`. Both bars are registered in QUARANTINE.json, which is why refuse(use='DEV') passes and use='CONFIRMATION' would not.
